units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣约略闻知了此事。

en.t: Yugiri, the Left Minister, heard something of this affair.

units.source_text: 本来，他决意要把六女公子嫁给薰中纳言。

en.t: Originally, he had resolved to marry his sixth daughter to Middle Counselor Kaoru.

units.source_text: 他想：“即使薰中纳言不肯爽快答应，但只要恳切要求，他终究不会拒否。”

en.t: He thought that even if Kaoru did not readily agree, he would surely not refuse in the end if asked earnestly enough.

units.source_text: 现在发生了这件意外之事，他心中非常妒恨。

en.t: Now that this unexpected thing had happened, his heart was filled with jealousy and resentment.

units.source_text: 念头一转，想道：“匂兵部卿亲王对我女儿虽然没有诚心，然而常常寄给她富有风情的书信，从未断绝。

en.t: Then his thoughts shifted, and he reflected that although Prince Niou, the Prince of the Ministry of War, had no sincere feeling for his daughter, he had often sent her elegant letters and had never stopped writing.

units.source_text: 即使是一时逢场作戏，总有前世宿缘，结果不会不爱她的。

en.t: Even if it began as a passing flirtation, there must be some bond from a former life, and in the end he could not fail to love her.

units.source_text: 嫁给出身低微的寻常人，即使‘密密深情不漏水’，毕竟没有面子，不能使我满意。”

en.t: If she married an ordinary man of low birth, even if his hidden devotion were perfectly discreet, it would still lack honor and could not satisfy me.

units.source_text: 继而又发牢骚：“在这人情浇薄的末世，女儿的事情甚可担心。

en.t: Then he grumbled further that in this degenerate age, when human feeling had grown so thin, a daughter’s affairs were deeply worrying.

units.source_text: 皇帝尚且要访求女婿，何况做臣下的，女儿过了青春真没办法呢。”

en.t: Even an emperor must search for a son-in-law; how much more helpless is a subject when his daughter’s youth has passed.

units.source_text: 此言含有对今上讥讽之意。

en.t: These words carried a note of sarcasm toward the reigning emperor.

units.source_text: 他就认真地请托妹妹明石皇后玉成六女公子与匂亲王之事。

en.t: He therefore earnestly asked his younger sister, the Akashi Empress, to help arrange the marriage between his sixth daughter and Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 屡次要求，明石皇后不胜其烦，对匂亲王说：“真可怜啊！

en.t: After repeated appeals, the Akashi Empress could no longer bear the bother and said to Prince Niou that it was truly pitiable.

units.source_text: 左大臣多年来如此热诚地要赘你为婿，你却与他作难，一味逃避，实在太无情了。

en.t: For so many years the Left Minister has been so eager to take you as his son-in-law, yet you keep making things difficult for him and only try to evade him; it is truly heartless.

units.source_text: 做皇子的，运气好坏全视外戚如何而定。

en.t: For an imperial prince, good or bad fortune depends entirely on the strength of his maternal relatives.

units.source_text: 今上常常说起，想让位给你哥哥。

en.t: The present emperor often says that he wishes to yield the throne to your elder brother.

units.source_text: 那时你就有当皇太子的希望了。

en.t: At that time, you would have hope of becoming crown prince.

units.source_text: 倘是臣下，则正夫人既定，不便分心另娶一人。

en.t: If one were merely a subject, then once a principal wife had been chosen, it would be awkward to divide one’s heart and take another wife.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，像夕雾左大臣那样非常认真的人，也有两位夫人，不是两方和睦相处，毫无妒恨么？

en.t: Even so, a man as serious as Yugiri, the Left Minister, has two wives, and do they not live together peacefully on both sides, without jealousy or resentment?

units.source_text: 何况是你，如果偿我宿愿而当了太子，则多娶几个女子，有何不可呢？”

en.t: How much more so for you: if you fulfill my long-cherished wish and become crown prince, what harm would there be in marrying several women?

units.source_text: 这一番话与往常不同，说得非常详细，而且理直气壮。

en.t: This speech was unlike her usual words; she spoke in great detail and with confident conviction.

units.source_text: 匂亲王心中本来就不是全然无意的，怎么会当作荒唐之言而断然拒绝呢？

en.t: Prince Niou had never been entirely uninterested in his heart, so how could he dismiss it as absurd talk and flatly refuse?

units.source_text: 他只是担心：当了夕雾的女婿，闭居在他那严肃刻板的府邸里，不能像向来那样任情取乐，倒是很痛苦的。

en.t: His only worry was that if he became Yugiri’s son-in-law and was shut up in that solemn, rigid household, unable to amuse himself freely as before, it would be very painful.

units.source_text: 但念过分和这位大臣结怨，确是很不应该，心思便渐渐地软下来。

en.t: But when he considered that it was truly improper to make such an enemy of this minister, his feelings gradually softened.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王原是个好色之徒，对按察大纳言红梅家女公子的恋情尚未断绝，每逢樱花红叶之时，常常去信叙情，觉得无论哪位女公子都可爱。

en.t: Yet Prince Niou was naturally amorous, and his passion for the daughter of the Inspector Grand Counselor Kobai’s family had not ended; whenever the cherry blossoms or autumn leaves came, he often sent letters expressing his feelings, finding every young lady lovable.

units.source_text: 就这样，这一年过去了。

en.t: In this way, the year passed.
